command.doc: dispatch one command line to the service, as the window and solaris-cc do; `wait` is refused (watch the events instead)

line.doc: one line of the Solaris command grammar (R-SVC-1) - every command is in apps/solaris/docs/API.md, and the `commands` method lists them

command.result: {output, revision} - output is what the command printed; a refusal fails with its reason

model.doc: the whole AppModel as JSON (what `state print --json` prints)

commands.doc: the command grammar: every command with its usage and summary

info.doc: A note worth logging; carries no state.

error.doc: Something failed. Also set as AppModel.lastError.

command.rejected.doc: A line was refused (R-SVC-3): unknown verb, flag, address or parameter; a refused edit.

project.synced.doc: The song's file changed under it and the song followed (R-COLLAB-1): how = reloaded (nothing unsaved here) | merged; theirs and mine = the changes each side brought; conflicts = the nodes asked about; renamed = new ids of mine renumbered.

project.changed.doc: A node was added, removed, moved or re-routed. what = e.g. strip.added, clip.moved, route.set. Every node a command makes is announced, one event each (R-SVC-8).

params.changed.doc: An address was written; value is what was STORED, canonical (a value out of range is refused, never clamped — R-SVC-8).

render.finished.doc: A render was written; peak is the master's, dBFS.

render.failed.doc: A render stopped with an error.

settings.changed.doc: A machine setting changed and was saved: sampleRate, bufferSize, output, input, port.<name>, folders, key.<action> (R-SET-4) …

browse.changed.doc: The browser now lists this folder — or, a search (path `search:<text>` / `favourites`), what it found.

library.changed.doc: R-PRESET-3: a file's tags (favourite among them) changed and were saved; tags comma-separated, '' none.

plugins.changed.doc: R-VST-6: a scan found this many plugins; problems: bundles that could not be read.

plugin.offline.doc: R-VST-6: a song's plugin is not playing — it never started, crashed or overran its budget; an effect passes dry, an instrument is silent (`device reload <dv>`). Said once.

surface.changed.doc: R-CTRL-2: the control surface connected (1) or not (0, why), or moved to another bank of eight.

map.learned.doc: R-CTRL-1: the MIDI control moved during a `map learn` is bound to the address (on its channel: `<ch>/<n>`).

plugin.editor.doc: R-VST-6: a plugin's own editor window opened (1) or closed (0) — by `device editor`, or its window's own close.

transport.changed.doc: Play, stop, seek or loop: playing 1/0, position in beats, loop `from-to` or `off`.

audition.changed.doc: A sample previewed from the browser started (playing 1) or ended — stopped, or to its end (playing 0).

note.previewed.doc: A note was heard through a strip, outside the song (`note preview`, the piano roll's sound — R-ROLL-7).

project.autosaved.doc: The unsaved song was written beside it (`<song>.autosave`, R-SAFE-1).

project.recovery.doc: The song just opened has an autosave newer than it (age in seconds) — `project recover` restores it, `project discard-recovery` drops it (R-SAFE-2).

record.finished.doc: A recording landed: its notes in this clip ('' — nothing was played) (R-MIDI-2); an audio take, how long it is (R-REC-1); how many takes a looped recording made (R-REC-2).

strip.armed.doc: The MIDI keyboard plays this strip now ('' — none); the session's, not the song's (R-MIDI-2).

chords.detected.doc: R-ASSIST-1: `chords detect` found n chords between beats from and to, replacing what was there (an edit's: said once it lands, after its chord.added lines).

meters.cleared.doc: The clip lights and held peaks are out; the master's true peak and integrated loudness start again (R-METER-2).

model.doc: the AppModel (state print --json), pushed on every revision (at most 25/s)

transport.doc: what moves without an edit, pushed when it changed (at most 20/s)
transport.data: {playing, position, loopFrom, loopTo, latencyMs, masterPeak, peaks: {<strip>: [l, r]}, audition, auditionPlaying, auditionProgress}
